title: Knell
extract:
The Knell is  Harrow's signature pistol that ultilizes its scope to more accurately land shots at long range. Although its magazine can only hold 1 round (2 rounds when equipped with Harrow), Weak Point Hits grant it infinite ammunition and increased critical multiplier and status chance for a short duration, making it a "high risk, high reward" weapon.

Characteristics
This weapon primarily deals  Puncture and  Impact damage.
Landing a successful Weak Point Hit grants the "Death Knell" buff, granting 100% Ammo Efficiency, increasing the final critical multiplier by +0.5x and increasing final status chance by 20%. Buffs can stack up to 3 times, with each stack lasting 2 seconds and can be refreshed on subsequent Weak Point Hits. Stacks decay one at a time, each lasting the full 2 seconds.
Precise at long range due to the scope feature.
Scope can be used even in Bleedout.

Acquisition
The Knell's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Notes
When used by  Harrow or  Harrow Prime, the Knell's magazine size is increased by 1 round, for a total of 2 rounds.
Death Knell increases final critical multiplier by +0.5x and final status chance by +20%. It also grants unlimited ammo. The buff lasts for 2 seconds and can be refreshed.
Critical multiplier and status chance bonus can stack up to 3 times. When the buff times out, one stack is lost and the buff duration resets.
Critical multiplier bonus is calculated as:
Crit Multiplier = 1.5 × (1 + Crit Damage Mods) + 0.5 × Number of Stacks
The buff triggers on weak points (however, some exceptions include the backpacks of most MOA variants). Similarly, shooting weakspots generated by either  Sonar or  Detect Vulnerability in places other than heads will have no effect either.
Weak Point Hits on corpses can proc Death Knell.
Individual Multishot bullets can proc Death Knell and can generate max stacks instantly from a single shot.
As an indication that this buff is active, the scope design while zoomed in will evolve, as well as showing the Death Knell buff in the UI.
The scope shows a 1.5x, 2.0x or 2.5x crit multiplier for the number of stacks respectively. However this does not represent the actual buff.

Tips
While the text specifies headshots, the buffs also trigger off of Weak Points, such as Rogue Culverin's arm canisters, Lumbering Fragment's midpoint, and The Anatomizer's midpoint.
Synergizes well with  Magnetize,  Scourge,  Harrow,  Arcane Precision,  Arcane Awakening, all other "On headshot" arcanes,  Hydraulic Crosshairs,  Orvius and  Prowl (only if using  Suppress). This is due to it having a fast reload, extremely small magazine, and the focus on scoring headshots.
Harrow's  Condemn, in particular, synergizes extremely well with Knell as chained enemies leave their heads very vulnerable to being shot at.
 Scourge also works particularly well with Knell, as the Bullet Attractor-like fields caused by throwing the speargun are created over the enemies' heads, and make it easier to land headshots.
Orvius' charged attack holds enemies in the air where they are open to headshots.
Combining a maxed  Primed Pistol Gambit with a maxed active  Hydraulic Crosshairs will give a combined 322% crit chance bonus, bringing crit chance for the Knell to 84.4%. Using  Galvanized Crosshairs instead at maximum stacks will increase this further to 507% crit chance bonus, boosting the total crit chance to 121.4% for guaranteed critical hits.
Works surprisingly well in conjunction with  Nyx's  Mind Control, as headshots on the controlled enemy will still trigger Death Knell, but they will not take damage until the ability ends. This way you can always have a big-headed-buddy of your choice nearby for easy activations.
 Pressurized Magazine can be very beneficial on this weapon, as it will increase the fire rate during the infinite ammo buff considerably if you can score a Weak Point Hit quickly after reloading.
 Seeker is also a viable mod for this pistol, especially when expecting enemies to spawn in a corridor such as the main hallway in a Void Defense mission, or when trying to score a headshot against an enemy hiding behind cover or Shield Lancers.

Trivia
A knell is the sound made by a bell, specifically when rung to signify a death or a funeral.
When viewed from overhead Knell resembles a cross, possibly in reference to  Harrow's priest/exorcist theme.
There is Tennobet engraved at the bottom of Knell's handle. This translates to "KUHT", which could mean "Cut".
